hero.description: The platform that digitizes tennis ladders and tournaments across Chile: your ranking and your progress, all in one place.

profiles.title: Player profiles
profiles.description: Create your profile and find rivals at your level.
profiles.modalBody: Your profile brings your level, match history and stats together in one place. Other players see it to propose challenges at your level, and you use it to choose who to play.

ladders.title: Ladders and tournaments
ladders.description: Compete in your club's ladder or in the ChileTenis Pro one.
ladders.modalBody: Ladders let you compete: as you play, you earn points that set your position in the ranking. ChileTenis Pro digitizes each club's ladder and runs a few tournaments a year.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.description: Challenge other players and play matches.
challenges.modalBody: On the profile of an available player with an active membership, a green button lets you challenge them to a friendly match, a great way to meet new players and gain experience. Only profiles with a paid membership can challenge and be challenged. If the player accepts, a private chat opens so you can agree on the day, time and place: a paid court or a free court in your area. Then enjoy a great match!

rankings.title: Automatic rankings
rankings.modalBody: Every ladder match you play adds points to your ranking. The result is logged by the ladder administrator (in ChileTenis Pro, you send us the score and we digitize it) and the system calculates everything automatically. Your ranking updates on the site as soon as the match is recorded, so you can follow your progress in this great sport.

clubs.title: Clubs
clubs.description: Each club with its own ladder and tournaments.
clubs.modalBody: Each club has its own independent space within ChileTenis PRO, with its ladder, tournaments and player community. ChileTenis Pro is not a club: it is the service that digitizes each club's ladder and stats.

challengeBanner.title: Find your next rival
challengeBanner.description: Play matches, improve your ranking and be part of the ChileTenis Pro community.

ranking.title: ChileTenis PRO Ranking
ranking.note: Adds up the real ladder points from each club.
ranking.empty: No players in the ranking yet.

clubCta.title: Have a club?
clubCta.description: We digitize your club's ladder: rankings, results and stats so your players can see their progress.
clubCta.emailSubject: I want to add my club to ChileTenis PRO
clubCta.emailBody: Hi, I'd like more information about adding my club to ChileTenis PRO.

recruit.title: We are building the ChileTenis Pro community
recruit.description: The ChileTenis Pro ladder needs critical mass. Once we reach the goal, it goes live with one weekly match, rankings, stats and tournaments. Leave your details and we will let you know.
recruit.statusOpen: The ladder is not open yet.
recruit.statusReached: We reached the goal! Registration opens soon.
recruit.consent: I agree that ChileTenis Pro uses my details only to contact me about the ladder.
recruit.thanks: Thanks! You are on the interest list.
recruit.alreadyIn: You were already on the list. Thanks for your interest!

errors.contacto: Please enter a valid WhatsApp number or email.
errors.consentimiento: You must accept the use of your details to continue.
errors.espera: Many requests right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.cerrado: Registration is not available right now.

recruit.price: Once the ladder is live, taking part costs ${{precio}} CLP per month (basic membership + ladder). Payment is due within the first {{dia}} days of each month; otherwise the profile is deactivated until the payment is settled. We will send you reminders.
